network.rpcChainMismatch: Not saved — this RPC reports chain {{reported}}, but this network is chain {{expected}}. The previous endpoint is still in use.
network.relayNotice: The relay that submits your transactions is sent this network's RPC address — including any API key in it — so it can reach the network you use.
network.fallback: Your node isn't answering — using public nodes for now
network.onlyMineHint: Nothing about your account goes to public nodes. If your node stops answering, this network can't be read until it's back.
network.hideBody: It leaves your network list. Its settings are kept, and Add Network brings it back anytime.
network.moreNetworks: Also supported, not in your list: {{names}}. Add one from Add Network.

rpcProviders.description: Add an API key to route supported networks through your own provider. Priority: per-network RPC, then your providers, then Vela built-in, then the chain index.
rpcProviders.relayNotice: The relay that submits your transactions is sent the RPC address your wallet uses for each network — including the API key in it — so it can reach the networks you use.

endpoints.description: Each can be replaced with one you host yourself.
endpoints.chainDataHint: Provides network info, token data, and chain logos
endpoints.passkeyHint: Stores passkey public keys for cross-device sign-in
endpoints.fiatHint: USD-based exchange rates that drive the currency list — swap for wider coverage.
endpoints.genesisHint: Finds multisigs and shares the transactions waiting for approval. It sees your multisigs' addresses and proposals, and never decides they're right — Vela checks every record and approval itself.
endpoints.resetBody: Every service goes back to Vela's own address. The addresses you entered here are forgotten.

addNetwork.description: Search by network name, token symbol, or Chain ID.
addNetwork.unableToVerify: Unable to verify — RPC request failed
addNetwork.noRpcEndpoint: No RPC endpoint is listed for this network. Enter one, then re-check.
addNetwork.incompatibleHint: Some contracts Vela needs aren't on this network yet. Chain Setup shows which ones and who can deploy them.
addNetwork.noP256Hint: This network can't check passkey signatures: it has no P-256 verifier (EIP-7951 / RIP-7212 at 0x100), and only the network's own team can add one. Vela wallets can't work here. Don't send money to your Vela address on this network. It would be stuck.
addNetwork.singleKeyOnly:
A wallet with more than one passkey cannot be created on this network: Safe's passkey signer factory is not deployed here.
A wallet with one passkey works normally.
addNetwork.discardBody: What you entered here will be lost.
addNetwork.velaNetworkHint: Vela supports this network. Adding it puts it back in your network list, with any settings you had for it.

health.urlRefused: Not saved — use an https:// address (plain http:// only for this computer). The previous address is still in use.

backup.title: Back up the account record on Ethereum
backup.couldNotCheck: Couldn't check. Tap to try again.
backup.cannotCopy: This older account can't be backed up
backup.explain: A new device finds this account through its public record on Gnosis. A copy on Ethereum lets it find the account even when Gnosis is down. It costs one Ethereum network fee. It doesn't back up your passkeys and can't move funds.

keys.title: Keys
keys.subtitle: Any one of them signs for this account on every network.
keys.subtitleSingle: This passkey signs for this account on every network.
keys.fromDevice: Couldn't reach the registry. Showing what this device remembers.

appearance.statusItemHint: Your total and quick Send and Receive, from the figures last loaded — nothing extra is fetched.
appearance.multisigNotificationsHint: Get notified when a multisig transaction needs your approval, gets an approval, is ready to execute, or is executed. Vela checks every minute while it's open; notifications come from this device, not a push service.
